The '''Koro-2 all-environment Exodrive airspeeder''',<ref name="USW" /> or just called the '''Koro-2 all-environment airspeeder'''<ref name="VE">''[[Star Wars: The Visual Encyclopedia]]''</ref> was an [[airspeeder]] manufactured by the [[Desler Gizh Outworld Mobility Corporation]] during the last decades of the [[Galactic Republic]].<ref name="USW" /> The [[Clawdite]] [[assassin]] [[Zam Wesell]] [[pilot]]ed a Koro-2 speeder, and utilized it to escape [[Jedi Knight]]s on [[Coruscant]] following her failed [[Plot to assassinate Senator Amidala|assassination]] of [[Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]].<ref name="AOTC">{{Film|II}}</ref>

==Design==
Manufactured by the [[Desler Gizh Outworld Mobility Corporation]], the Koro-2 was powered by an uncommon external electromagnetic propulsion system. The [[airspeeder]]'s forward mandibles induced ionization in the air around the vessel as it flew, making them conductive to allow paired electrodes to electrify the airstream and magnetically propel it towards the rear. This resulted in the air dragging the speeder forwards, obtaining atmospheric speeds of up to eight hundred [[Kilometer per hour|kilometers per hour]]. The lean craft featured a pressurized cabin that could seat two<ref name="USW" /> with an air supply of two weeks, allowing it to travel, to a limited degree, underwater or in space.<ref name="ESOV" />
